defect.cause: gallery, carousel, tabs, accordion and dropdown Accessible Name paths called String() on persisted ariaLabel values; table caption was interpolated as a string. A malformed object with a non-callable toString throws during rendering.

reproduction.result: Each type threw TypeError: Cannot convert object to primitive value before the fix.

defect.fix: Reuse the renderer's string-only trimmedText helper for authored group labels and table captions. Valid labels are trimmed and capped at 160 characters; blank or malformed group labels receive localized safe defaults. Table caption is normalized for both region name and visible caption, with Táblázat as the fallback.
defect.savePublish: Only rendered output is normalized. The Page Model is not rewritten; the existing Save and separate Publish actions remain distinct.
